items.name: Bangabandhu Cube Open Chattogram 2020
items.information:
# This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHNNIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--52bd99163d7e228b9f96be45c33b2fcd799cb5d1/BCO20-02.png)
It's the first WCA competition in Chattogram city. We hope it will be enjoyable for everybody. Necessary details are provided in the tabs. Still you can [contact](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BangabandhuCubeOpenCTG2020#14483-contact) us for any queries.
